item.title: Community Edition
item.description: KubeSphere Community Edition supports deployment on any infrastructure, offering both online and offline installation, one-click cluster upgrades and scaling, and provides features such as multi-tenancy, multi-cluster management, cloud-native observability, application lifecycle management, and DevOps. By using KubeSphere Community Edition, you will enjoy continuously iterated enterprise-grade features for free, making it easy to build the cornerstone of cloud-native.
